# Sairam Krishnan

> Software engineering leader at Apple and Wharton MBA 2026. Eleven years
> building data and ML platforms, then the teams that ship them. Publishes
> research on managing engineering teams in the age of generative AI and on
> evaluating enterprise AI return on investment, and builds independent
> products end to end.

Current role: Principal Software Engineer and AI/ML platform lead at Apple,
leading an eight-engineer team across three continents on platforms serving
more than 100 million users. Previously Amazon (Senior Software Engineer,
Alexa), Susquehanna International Group, Microsoft, and Amazon Web Services.
Executive MBA from The Wharton School, Class of 2026, with five majors.
Dual degrees in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Carnegie Mellon.

Open to Senior Engineering Manager and Head of AI/ML Engineering roles, and
to speaking engagements and executive workshops.

## Research

- Who Trains the Next Senior? Managing engineering teams when AI makes code
  cheap. SSRN, 2026. DOI 10.2139/ssrn.7083078. Co-authored with Gajendra Babu Thokala.
- A Multi-Layer Framework for Evaluating the ROI of AI Projects. SSRN, 2026.
  DOI 10.2139/ssrn.6732598. Faculty sponsor Prof. Gad Allon, The Wharton School.
- Drone-Megaddon: commanding drone swarms like a real-time strategy game.
  engrXiv. 2014 original DOI 10.31224/6924; 2026 extension DOI 10.31224/6987.

## Documented impact

- $40M saved per year at Amazon Alexa, via a batching and clustering approach
  to Alexa Core Engine data mining that also improved model accuracy 40%.
- Apple's media knowledge graph unifying metadata from 15+ sources, powering
  search, recommendations, and discovery for 100M+ users.
- 40% better data quality and 30% faster delivery at Apple.

## Honors

Benjamin Franklin Award (peer-voted, one of three in a class of 250), Palmer
Scholar, Graduation With Honors, First Year Honors, Director's List in all six
terms — all The Wharton School. Dean's List all three years at Carnegie
Institute of Technology. Jesse Jones Scholarship, Houston Endowment. National
Merit Finalist.
